title: DesignToken
description: A named design decision (a colour, spacing step, font size, radius, duration or shadow) that a UX library or application exposes as a single value its components read, so the look can be themed without changing component code. Tokens are usually published as CSS custom properties, a token JSON file or a theme object. Use StatePattern instead when the element is a reusable behaviour or state shape (light and dark mode as a state a component switches between) rather than a value. Use LayoutConfig instead when the element is a layout arrangement of a view rather than a named value. Individual tokens are elements only when a maintainer names them; a token set is usually one element.
x-dr-standard: W3C Design Tokens Community Group format
x-dr-evidence: A stylesheet whose :root block declares CSS custom properties consumed by components, e.g. --hd-color-edge, --hd-space-2
A tokens.json or *.tokens.json file in the Design Tokens Community Group format
A theme object exported by a library and passed to a provider component

x-dr-distinguish.ux.statepattern: the element is a reusable behaviour or state shape (light and dark mode as a state a component switches between) rather than a value
x-dr-distinguish.ux.layoutconfig: the element is a layout arrangement of a view rather than a named value
